---
name: Feature or experiment
about: Propose an improvement or share an experiment
labels: enhancement, proposal
---

## The problem or opportunity

Who would this help, and what would they be able to do?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful version. Link related issues or experiments.

## Scope and dependencies

What parts of the client, simulation, API or infrastructure would change?
Separate current capability from proposed behavior.

## Acceptance

How could a contributor demonstrate that this works?

## Contribution

Share what you can help with, if anything. Independent-world experiments are
welcome; explain which parts could also improve the shared engine.
